subject: Follow-up: Trial scope, governance checklist, and decision timeline
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@veritashealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@veritashealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood trial scope & next steps

Hi Priya / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo today — appreciate the clear walkthrough. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can lock the POC timeline: 

- Success criteria (what we care about):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 600ms for our 128-token queries under a 10 qps sustained load.
  - Quality: intent-match >= 92% on our 500-sample test set (we'll provide labeled examples).
  - Safety/filt: redaction of PHI tokens and an evidence/log showing sensitive span masking.
  - Costs: estimated USD/month for the projected qps and token mix (dev vs. prod).

- Data / access: we can deliver a 10k sample payload (synthetic PII-masked) by 9/17. We will need a secure upload mechanism and confirmation that data stays in us-west.
- Timeline idea: start POC week of 9/21, run 2 weeks, exec readout week of 10/5.

Can you confirm those dates/owners and send a short POC runbook we can share internally? Also please attach any template SOW / procurement notes — procurement will want cost and termination terms upfront.

Attachments: veritas_poc_requirements.pdf

Best,
Ellen Park
VP Product, Veritas Health
ellen.park@veritashealth.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@veritashealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@veritashealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood trial scope & next steps

Thanks Ellen — great notes and very aligned. Quick confirmation and proposed plan below.

POC objective: demonstrate production-acceptable latency, quality on your labeled set, and safe handling of PHI under a controlled dataset.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Kickoff & access (owners):
  - Data & upload (Veritas) -> Ellen / Tom to deliver sanitized samples by 2026-09-17.
  - Infra & endpoints (Redwood) -> Connor to provision a dedicated trial endpoint in us-west and share credentials by 2026-09-20.
- Trial window: 2026-09-21 through 2026-10-04 (14 calendar days).
- Instrumentation & metrics:
  - Redwood will emit token-level latency histograms, 95th/99th latencies, and per-request safety flags. Connor will map event names to your labels.
- Acceptance gates (must meet at least 3 of 4):
  1) 95th pctl latency < 600ms at 10 qps (or documented graceful degradation plan).
  2) Intent-match >= 92% on your 500-sample set.
  3) No PHI leakage in redaction checks across a 1k audit sample.
  4) Monthly cost estimate within the threshold you provide (we'll model after dataset upload).
- Exec readout: proposed slots 2026-10-05 or 2026-10-06; recommend 30–45 minute executive summary + demo. Rishi will own the exec narrative.
- Procurement / contract step: we can produce a short SOW and a subscription estimate once the trial metrics are in — Marissa will draft baseline SOW and post-POC pricing options.

Attachments: redwood_poc-template.xlsx (POC runbook + measurement spreadsheet).
HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/20482/VER-4321

Next actions (Priya):
1) Connor provisions endpoint and shares creds by 9/20.
2) Ellen shares sanitized dataset by 9/17.
3) Marissa drafts SOW template during the trial to fast-track contract.

If that all sounds good I'll send calendar invites for kickoff (9/21) and block the exec readout tentative slots.

Thanks — looking forward,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@veritashealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@veritashealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood trial scope & next steps

On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Priya Natarajan wrote:
> Proposed plan (high level):
> - Kickoff & access (owners): Connor to provision a dedicated trial endpoint in us-west and share credentials by 2026-09-20.

Quick technical notes & ask from infra/ops side so we don't hit blockers once the data lands:
- Endpoint: I'll spin up a controlled trial instance on a dedicated GPU pool (pinned quantized model variant) with a single auth token. Expect hostname + creds by 9/20 EOD.
- Workload sizing: your 10 qps sustained with 128-token median looks fine; we'll also run a 10m soak at the target qps on day 2 to validate stability.
- Data upload: please SFTP to the temp bucket I'll provision (I'll share the upload instructions). We need the sample set in CSV/NDJSON with a label column for intent.
- Safety testing: to validate PHI redaction we'll run redaction scans and a 1k audit sample; if any escape occurs we'll pause and trace the request payloads.
- Telemetry: we'll push a light Grafana dashboard and a CSV export of evaluation metrics you can ingest. If Veritas has an ingestion endpoint, we can push metrics there as well.

I'll add the provisioning tasks to a shared runbook and ping when credentials are ready.

—Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@veritashealth.com>

Date: 2026-09-21T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood trial scope & next steps

Priya / Connor — all good from our side. Quick confirmations: 

- We will deliver sanitized dataset (10k rows, labels) to the SFTP bucket on 2026-09-17 as planned.
- POC kickoff confirmed 2026-09-21.
- Exec readout: we'll take 2026-10-05 at 10:00 AM PT (please send calendar invite).
- Procurement note: procurement would like a draft SOW and a short list of termination & data-retention terms prior to the readout. If you can share the draft SOW during the trial (Marissa), that will help expedite approvals.

Tom and I will be the internal owners for acceptance and procurement questions. Once we have the trial metrics we'll route a go/no-go recommendation to our execs immediately after the readout.

Thanks — Ellen
